row.statement: When collecting, recording and reporting suspected adverse reactions, the MAH must treat as abuse of a medicinal product any persistent or sporadic, intentional excessive use of medicinal products accompanied by harmful physical or psychological effects (Directive 2001/83/EC Art 1(16)).

row.statement: Outside clinical trials, the MAH should treat as an adverse event any untoward medical occurrence in a patient given a medicinal product, including any unfavourable and unintended sign (e.g. abnormal laboratory finding), symptom or disease temporally associated with its use, whether or not considered related.
